title: Catch-up import runs at about 1.3 articles a second (peer_catchup imports ~780 of 1000 in a 600 s round on hbox): the pull worker ends a selection at every spool, local, send and digest step (about 25 worker hand-offs an ~2 KiB article, 32 of them 64-octet digest reads), reads only the selection's last action as progress, and pauses ACL2's 10 ms I/O poll on the owner commit signal, which neither a spool worker nor a local submission raises; every selection also re-reads both plan tables under the owner
